usage: deskops add task [-h] [--from-yaml FROM_YAML] [--root ROOT]
                        [--title TITLE] [--why WHY] [--goal GOAL]
                        [--scope SCOPE]
                        [--implementation-path IMPLEMENTATION_PATH]
                        [--done-when DONE_WHEN] [--from-drawer FROM_DRAWER]
                        [--validation VALIDATION [VALIDATION ...]]
                        [--depends-on DEPENDS_ON [DEPENDS_ON ...]]
                        [--task-type TASK_TYPE]
                        [--evidence EVIDENCE [EVIDENCE ...]]
                        [--inherits-from INHERITS_FROM [INHERITS_FROM ...]]
                        [--atom ATOM [ATOM ...]]
                        [--inherit-acceptance-context]
                        [payload]

Create an actionable task bundle.

positional arguments:
  payload               Inline JSON payload for the task.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --from-yaml FROM_YAML
                        Load the task payload from a YAML file.
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --title TITLE         Task title
  --why WHY             Rationale or business driver
  --goal GOAL           Task goal
  --scope SCOPE         Task scope
  --implementation-path IMPLEMENTATION_PATH
                        Implementation path
  --done-when DONE_WHEN
                        Task completion rule
  --from-drawer FROM_DRAWER
                        Drawer file this task is authored from (path, stem, or
                        slug fragment). Recorded in the task's from_drawer
                        field; the drawer file is kept for manual cleanup.
  --validation VALIDATION [VALIDATION ...]
                        Validation command or assertion; repeat or space-
                        separate as needed.
  --depends-on DEPENDS_ON [DEPENDS_ON ...]
                        Task identifiers that must complete first; repeat or
                        space-separate as needed.
  --task-type TASK_TYPE
                        Workflow task type; one of the registered types
                        (task.code, task.docs, task.debug, task.refactor,
                        task.decision, task.aggregate, task.external, plus any
                        desk-local type registered from desk/models/*.py).
                        Defaults to task.code.
  --evidence EVIDENCE [EVIDENCE ...]
                        Closeout evidence kinds: tests, commit, atom,
                        materialization, document, external. The task type
                        declares its own evidence as a floor; --evidence may
                        only add kinds, never remove one the type requires.
  --inherits-from INHERITS_FROM [INHERITS_FROM ...]
                        Task identifiers that provide inherited workflow
                        context; repeat or space-separate as needed.
  --atom ATOM [ATOM ...]
                        Workflow or knowledge atom refs bound to the task;
                        repeat or space-separate as needed.
  --inherit-acceptance-context
                        Inherit validation and done-when context from tasks
                        listed in --inherits-from.

Examples:
  deskops add task --root . --title "Fix thing" --goal "..." --scope "..." --validation "pytest" --task-type task.code
  deskops add task --root . --title "Document the API" --goal "..." --scope "..." --task-type task.docs

The task type declares how the task closes; --evidence only adds kinds to the type's
floor. Without --task-type the type is task.code.
